title: Little Havana French Gourmet Guided Tour
includes: personal expenses, consumption other than those planned, the guide's tip (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Tastings include meat, particularly pork. Let us know for a suitable menu.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Throughout an exclusive and gourmet guided walking tour in French, full of anecdotes about the city and Cuban culture, discover Little Havana and its Calle Ocho, the most Cuban neighborhood in Miami, in the company of a guide French-speaking local.
A 2.5 hour journey from which you will emerge satisfied, and a break in your trip, during which you will forget that you are still in Miami!
On the menu: strong coffee, empañadas, sugar cane juice, plantain, and many other delights!
